findings.evidence_title: Time-limited countdown timer on policy purchase page
remediation_fix: Remove artificial countdown timers
Allow customers unrestricted time to review terms
Provide clear information about actual policy availability

findings.evidence_title: Fake stock depletion indicators suggesting limited policy slots
remediation_fix: Remove false stock indicators
Display accurate policy availability information
Avoid pressure tactics suggesting limited supply

findings.evidence_title: Third-party policy recommendations styled as customer reviews
remediation_fix: Clearly label paid partnerships and sponsored content
Distinguish between verified customer reviews and promotional content
Disclose affiliate relationships prominently

findings.evidence_title: Insurance comparison charts with hidden bias toward premium plans
remediation_fix: Present all plan options equally without visual bias
Use neutral comparison layouts
Clearly indicate any sponsored or featured positions

findings.evidence_title: Persistent pop-ups appearing every 30 seconds during form filling
remediation_fix: Implement frequency caps on pop-ups
Provide dismiss buttons that remain available
Respect user preferences for notifications

findings.evidence_title: Mandatory acceptance of promotional communications to proceed with purchase
remediation_fix: Make opt-ins truly optional
Provide clear opt-out mechanisms
Allow users to proceed without accepting promotional communications

findings.evidence_title: Auto-renewal checkbox pre-checked on renewal consent screen
remediation_fix: Require explicit user consent for auto-renewal
Present renewal terms clearly and prominently
Provide easy cancellation options

findings.evidence_title: Confusing double-negative wording in policy exclusions
remediation_fix: Use clear, plain language for policy terms
Avoid double negatives and confusing phrasing
Provide examples of what is and is not covered

findings.evidence_title: Additional mandatory fees revealed only at final checkout step
remediation_fix: Display total price upfront including all mandatory fees
Break down cost components transparently
Avoid surprise charges at checkout

findings.evidence_title: Influencer testimonials without clear disclosure of sponsorship
remediation_fix: Add prominent #ad or sponsored tags to influencer content
Disclose all payment relationships with testimonial providers
Use standard industry disclosures for endorsements

findings.evidence_title: Critical cancel button obscured by overlapping modal dialogs
remediation_fix: Ensure cancel and close buttons are always clearly visible
Avoid overlapping modal dialogs
Test interface accessibility across all screen sizes

findings.evidence_title: Terms and conditions link styled to blend with background
remediation_fix: Use distinct styling for important links
Ensure sufficient color contrast per WCAG standards
Make terms and conditions easily discoverable

findings.evidence_title: Biometric verification mandatory for policy activation
remediation_fix: Provide alternative authentication methods
Allow customers to use traditional verification if needed
Document accessibility accommodations
